meta.title: Umrah & Hajj, Step by Step: Illustrated Guides
meta.description: Free illustrated guides to performing Umrah and Hajj, with animated diagrams of every rite and the Arabic du'as with translations. In English, French, German, Spanish and Arabic.
meta.share: Illustrated guides to Umrah and Hajj, with moving diagrams and the words to say at every rite.
meta.imageAlt: Umrah & Hajj, Step by Step: two guides
home.title: Illustrated guides to Umrah and Hajj
home.lede: Choose a guide. Each one walks you through the rites one at a time, with moving diagrams and the words to say.
home.umrahMeta: 6 steps, from the miqat to cutting the hair
home.umrahP: Six rites, walked through one at a time with moving diagrams, so you know where to stand, which way to turn and what to say before you arrive.
home.hajjMeta: 8 steps, from the 8th to the 13th of Dhul Hijjah
home.hajjP: Five days, four places and eight rites, each shown as a moving diagram with the words to say, so you can see the whole pilgrimage before you begin it.
home.hajjSvg: A pilgrim travelling between Makkah, Mina and Arafah
foot.p: These guides follow widely accepted practice. Some details differ between schools of thought, so check points that matter to you with a scholar or your group leader.
foot.fine: Diagrams are simplified and not to scale.
